THE LAST LIGHT

Write the way
to morning.

Type the words from left to right. Your keystrokes carry a lantern-bearing traveler through seven hand-drawn scenes. He settles into a breathing idle when you stop on solid ground.

01

Space finishes each word. Backspace fixes a mistake before submission. Follow the letters and punctuation exactly. Incorrect letters turn red; extras appear in darker red. Submitted mistakes stay underlined.

02

Punctuation makes you jump. Typing the punctuation at the end of a word finishes it automatically. Commas and other punctuation launch a single jump; a period launches a double jump. Spaces between ordinary words never ask for a jump. Keep typing in midair to speed up the landing.

03

The fight stands its ground. Words replace one another beneath your feet. Claw lunges and a wing sweep lead into fire. Raise the empty lantern and capture the dragon’s breath to light it. Type spun to launch a complete spinning wave of light. The defeated keeper bows and opens the cave.

04

The light gives second chances. You can type as soon as he respawns, without waiting for him to stand up. Chapter accuracy tracks your keystrokes and resets with each new chapter. Mistakes are allowed while accuracy remains at least 85%. Falling below 85% returns you to the start of this chapter. Backspacing fixes the letters but keeps the mistake in your accuracy.

Finish all seven scenes to see the ending. Escape pauses, including a leap in progress. Reduced motion is supported. Classic v1 is available in the header.
